Thanks Lukas — that helps. A few clarifying points from our tax team (see inline):

> Redwood Inference will issue invoices from Redwood Ireland Ltd (EU VAT ID: IE1234567V).
We need a copy of the certificate that shows active VAT registration rather than just a VAT number. The attachment looks like a registration summary — can you confirm it's the official certificate?

> We can invoice the Irish entity and accept payment to our EUR bank account (SEPA) or continue to route to the UK entity if that is easier for your AP team.
Our preference is to receive invoices from the Irish entity and pay to an Irish bank account. However, our payment platform needs: payee legal name, IBAN, bank BIC, and confirmation there are no domestic withholding obligations (for example, GST/withholding in APAC is not relevant but UK IR35-style withholdings are not applicable).

Also: if Redwood elects reverse-charge, please ensure the invoice contains the following line for our audit: 
"Reverse charge — article XX; customer liable for VAT" (or similar statutory language for the UK/EU).

We'll aim to return the signed self-billing consent by EOD tomorrow if the samples look standard.

One more ask: can you add Marissa on any billing follow-ups (cc'd) so we can avoid back-and-forth?

Best,
Priya
